articles.title: GSK (LSE:GSK) Wins EMA Panel Backing For Bexsero Booster From Age 10
articles.summary: GSK (LSE:GSK) received a positive opinion from the EMA's CHMP on an updated Bexsero label for adolescents and young adults. The panel backed a single Bexsero booster dose for individuals aged 10 years and older, supported by Phase IIIb trial data. The proposed label change would extend Bexsero use beyond infancy in key European markets, including older children and young adults. articles.title: What Does GSK (LSE:GSK) FDA Lung Cancer Approval Change For Investors?
articles.summary: GSK (LSE:GSK) received FDA accelerated approval for Nelkarmi (neladalkib) in advanced ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer. The decision covers adults with previously treated ALK-positive NSCLC, including those with brain metastases or resistance to earlier ALK inhibitors. Approval is based on the ALKOVE-1 study, which reported durable responses in heavily pretreated patients with advanced disease.
